1.text: Icyo gihe Umwami Herode yumvise inkuru ya Yesu,

2.text: abwira abagaragu be ati “Uwo ni Yohana Umubatiza wazutse, ni cyo gituma akora ibitangaza.”

3.text: Kuko Herode yari yarafashe Yohana akamuboha, akamushyira mu nzu y'imbohe ku bwa Herodiya wari muka mwene se Filipo,

4.text: kuko Yohana yari yabwiye Herode ati “Amategeko ntiyemera ko umucyura.”

5.text: Yifuzaga kumwica ariko atinya abantu, kuko bemeraga ko ari umuhanuzi.

6.text: Umunsi wo kwibuka kuvuka kwa Herode usohoye, umukobwa wa Herodiya abyinira imbere y'abararitswe, ashimisha Herode.

7.text: Ni cyo cyatumye asezerana arahira ko amuha icyo amusaba cyose.

8.text: Na we amaze koshywa na nyina aramubwira ati “Mpa igihanga cya Yohana Umubatiza ku mbehe.”

9.text: Umwami arababara, ariko ategeka ko bakimuha ku bw'indahiro yarahiriye imbere y'abasangiraga na we,

10.text: atuma mu nzu y'imbohe ngo bace igihanga cya Yohana.

11.text: Bazana igihanga cye ku mbehe bagiha umukobwa, agishyīra nyina.

12.text: Abigishwa be barazabajyana umurambo, barawuhamba maze bajya kubibwira Yesu.

13.text: Yesu abyumvise arahava, agenda mu bwato ajya aho abantu bataba kwiherera. Abantu benshi babyumvise bava mu midugudu baramukurikira, baca iy'ubutaka.

14.text: Yomotse abona abantu benshi arabababarira, abakiriza abarwayi.

15.text: Umunsi ukuze, abigishwa be baramwegera bati “Aha ngaha ntihagira abantu none umunsi urakuze, sezerera abantu bajye mu birorero bīhahire ibyokurya.”

16.text: Yesu arabasubiza ati “Ntakibajyanayo, mube ari mwe mubagaburira.”

17.text: Baramusubiza bati “Nta cyo dufite hano, keretse imitsima itanu n'ifi ebyiri.”

19.text: Ategeka abantu ko bicara mu byatsi, yenda iyo mitsima itanu n'izo fi ebyiri, arararama areba mu ijuru arabishimira, amanyagura iyo mitsima ayiha abigishwa be, abigishwa bayiha abantu.

20.text: Bararya bose barahāga, bateranya ubuvungukira bw'imitsima busigaye, bwuzura intonga cumi n'ebyiri.

21.text: Abariye bari nk'ibihumbi bitanu, abagore n'abana batabariwemo.

22.text: Uwo mwanya ahata abigishwa be ngo bikire mu bwato babanze hakurya, amare gusezerera abantu.

23.text: Amaze kubasezerera aragenda, azamuka umusozi wenyine ajya gusenga. Bwari bugorobye, ari yo wenyine.

24.text: Ariko ubwato bugeze imuhengeri buteraganwa n'umuraba, kuko umuyaga ubaturutse imbere.

25.text: Nuko mu nkoko aza aho bari agendesha amaguru hejuru y'inyanja.

26.text: Ariko abigishwa bamubonye agendesha amaguru hejuru y'inyanja bahagarika imitima, batakishwa n'ubwoba bati “Ni umuzimu.”

27.text: Ariko uwo mwanya Yesu avugana na bo ati “Nimuhumure ni jyewe, mwitinya.”

28.text: Petero aramusubiza ati “Mwami niba ari wowe, untegeke nze aho uri ngendesha amaguru hejuru y'amazi.”

29.text: Aramusubiza ati “Ngwino.” Petero ava mu bwato, agendesha amaguru hejuru y'amazi ngo asange Yesu.

30.text: Ariko abonye umuyaga ko ari mwinshi aratinya, atangiye kurengerwa arataka ati “Databuja nkiza.”

31.text: Uwo mwanya Yesu arambura ukuboko kwe aramufata, aramubwira ati “Yewe ufite kwizera guke we, ni iki gitumye ushidikanya?”

32.text: Baratambuka bajya mu bwato, umuyaga uratuza.

33.text: Abari mu bwato baramupfukamira, baramubwira bati “Ni ukuri uri Umwana w'Imana.”

34.text: Nuko bamaze gufata hakurya, bagera imusozi mu gihugu cy'i Genesareti.

35.text: Ab'aho baramumenya, batuma muri icyo gihugu cyose bamuzanira abarwayi bose,

36.text: baramwinginga ngo bakore ku nshunda z'umwenda we gusa, abazikozeho bose barakira.
